stories.headline: ASML beats Q2, raises 2026 sales outlook to €43-45B and plans 30% capacity expansion on AI demand

key_facts.fact: ASML reported Q2 2026 total net sales of €9.33 billion (up 21% year-on-year), beating the €8.80 billion analyst estimate, with net income of €2.92 billion versus an expected €2.62 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Q2 total net sales of €9.3 billion, gross margin of 54.0%, net income of €2.9 billion

key_facts.fact: ASML raised its full-year 2026 net sales forecast to €43 billion-€45 billion, up from a prior €36 billion-€40 billion range, about a 16% increase at the midpoint.
key_facts.excerpt: it now expects full-year 2026 net revenue of €43 billion to €45 billion ($49 billion to $51 billion), an increase of 16% at the midpoint from its earlier forecast range of €36 billion to €40 billion

key_facts.fact: ASML guided Q3 2026 total net sales to €11.0 billion-€12.0 billion with a gross margin of 55%-57%.
key_facts.excerpt: ASML expects Q3 2026 total net sales between €11.0 billion and €12.0 billion, and a gross margin between 55% and 57%

key_facts.fact: Citing 'extremely strong' order intake, ASML said it plans to add about 30% to its low-NA EUV capacity and DUV immersion capacity for 2027, and is investigating a further 30% increase for 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: we are planning to add 30% to our 2026 low NA EUV capacity of around 65 for 2027, and we are investigating to increase capacity with another 30% for 2028

stories.headline: Intel Foundry becomes first to ship high-volume logic on ASML's High NA EUV with Panther Lake chips

key_facts.fact: ASML said Intel Foundry has entered high-volume manufacturing for a subset of Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors, code-named Panther Lake, using ASML's EXE High NA EUV technology on the Intel 18A process node.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel Foundry has entered high-volume manufacturing for a subset of Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors, code-named Panther Lake, using ASML's EXE High NA EUV technology

key_facts.fact: With the announcement, Intel Foundry became the first company in the industry to ship a high-volume logic product using High NA EUV, with specific Intel 18A layers dual-qualified on High NA in Oregon at yields matched to the NXE platform.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel Foundry is first in the industry to ship high-volume logic product using High NA EUV

key_facts.fact: The High NA EUV equipment costs around $400 million per machine, roughly double the price of a standard EUV tool, and is technically challenging to introduce into production; Intel is using it only for specific chip layers.
key_facts.excerpt: The High NA equipment costs around $400 million, or twice as much as the standard EUV machine... Intel is using the High NA tool for specific layers of the chip

stories.headline: India's Cabinet approves Semicon 2.0 with a Rs 1.27 lakh crore chipmaking package, expanding beyond fabs

key_facts.fact: India's Union Cabinet, chaired by PM Narendra Modi, approved Semicon 2.0 (India Semiconductor Mission 2.0) on July 15 with a Rs 1.27 lakh crore (roughly $13-14 billion) outlay.
key_facts.excerpt: Cabinet approves Semiconductor Mission 2.0 with Rs 1.27 lakh crore outlay

key_facts.fact: The new allocation is a sharp increase from the Rs 76,000 crore approved under the first phase of the India Semiconductor Mission, launched in December 2021.
key_facts.excerpt: representing a sharp increase from the ₹76,000 crore allocated under the first phase of the programme

key_facts.fact: ISM 2.0 will run over 10 to 12 years and extends incentives beyond fabrication to semiconductor design companies, materials manufacturers and equipment suppliers, aiming to build India's entire chip value chain.
key_facts.excerpt: ISM 2.0 will be implemented over 10 to 12 years... the scheme will extend incentives to semiconductor design companies, materials manufacturers, equipment suppliers and other upstream and downstream participants

stories.headline: Toyota-backed Walden Robotics exits stealth with $300M seed at a $1.1B valuation

key_facts.fact: Walden Robotics launched out of stealth with $300 million in funding at a $1.1 billion valuation, co-led by Toyota (Toyota Motor Corp, Toyota Invention Partners and Toyota Ventures) and Deviation Capital.
key_facts.excerpt: launched out of stealth with $300 million in funding. The round, which values the company at $1.1 billion, is co-led by Toyota... and Deviation Capital

key_facts.fact: Backers of the round include NVIDIA, Boeing, AE Ventures, Samsung Ventures, Prologis Ventures and CoreWeave Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: with participation from NVIDIA, Boeing, AE Ventures, Samsung Ventures, Prologis Ventures, CoreWeave Ventures

key_facts.fact: The Cambridge, Massachusetts company spun out of Toyota Research Institute in January 2026, and since February its general-purpose robots have been doing production work at a Toyota plant in North America.
key_facts.excerpt: Walden launched out of Toyota Research Institute in January 2026... Since February, Walden's general-purpose robots have been doing useful work in production at a Toyota plant in North America

key_facts.fact: Walden builds general-purpose (wheeled humanoid) robots powered by Large Behavior Models that learn and improve while performing real work in manufacturing and logistics.
key_facts.excerpt: The Cambridge, Massachusetts-based company produces its own hardware, software and artificial intelligence models to build general-purpose humanoid robots

stories.headline: Nokia launches 'industry-first' commercial AI-RAN platform built with Nvidia

key_facts.fact: On July 15 Nokia announced what it called the industry's first commercial AI-RAN platform, developed with Nvidia and built on Nokia's anyRAN software and Nvidia's Aerial AI-RAN accelerated computing technology.
key_facts.excerpt: Nokia announced what it described as the industry's first commercial AI-RAN platform, developed in partnership with Nvidia... built on Nokia's anyRAN software and Nvidia's Aerial AI-RAN accelerated computing technology

key_facts.fact: The platform has demonstrated spectral efficiency gains of more than 20%, with Nokia targeting 50% by 2027 and more than 100% by 2028; commercial availability is planned for 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: the platform has demonstrated spectral efficiency gains of more than 20%, with the company targeting 50% gains by 2027 and more than 100% by 2028... commercial availability planned for 2027

key_facts.fact: Operators would buy the capability via a software subscription rather than a hardware refresh, choosing from three deployment paths: a GPU-powered plug-in card for existing AirScale sites, a standalone AI-RAN node, or cloud-native COTS servers.
key_facts.excerpt: Operators would buy the capability through a software subscription rather than a hardware refresh, choosing from three deployment options: a GPU-powered plug-in card for existing AirScale sites, a standalone AI-RAN node, and a cloud-server build

key_facts.fact: Nokia CEO Justin Hotard called AI-RAN 'the biggest innovation in radio in decades,' while Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang called the collaboration 'a generational shift for operators.'
key_facts.excerpt: "AI-RAN is the biggest innovation in radio in decades," said Justin Hotard... Jensen Huang said the collaboration aims to bring Nvidia CUDA and AI into the baseband, calling it "a generational shift for operators."

stories.headline: PJM capacity auction adds $6.3B to power bills in 13 states, driven by data-center demand

key_facts.fact: PJM Interconnection, the largest U.S. grid operator, released the results of a capacity auction on Tuesday July 14 that would add $6.3 billion in costs to the bills of households and businesses over the next three years, driven by data-center power demand.
key_facts.excerpt: PJM... on Tuesday released results of an electricity auction that would add $6.3 billion in costs to the bills of millions of households and businesses within the next three years, an increase driven by the power demands of data centers

key_facts.fact: The auction cleared at $325 per megawatt-day for 2028 and 2029, the maximum under a price cap initially negotiated by Pennsylvania's Shapiro administration after the 2024 auction closed at a record $269.92 per megawatt-day.
key_facts.excerpt: The $325-per-megawatt-day price for generating capacity in 2028 and 2029 is at the maximum price under a cap initially negotiated by the Shapiro administration last year after the 2024 auction closed at a record price of $269.92 per megawatt-day

key_facts.fact: The auction fell 6,831 megawatts short of PJM's capacity goal, a larger deficit than the prior year, amid retiring fossil-fuel plants and proposed data-center development across the 13-state region and Washington, D.C.
key_facts.excerpt: PJM also announced Tuesday that the auction fell 6,831 megawatts short of the grid manager's capacity goal, which is a larger deficit than in last year's auction

sources.title: Data Centers to Add Billions in Power Costs in 13 States

stories.headline: CoreWeave explores derivatives to hedge against a future drop in memory-chip prices

key_facts.fact: AI cloud company CoreWeave is exploring the use of financial derivatives, including put options, as a potential hedge against a future drop in memory and storage chip prices, though discussions are early-stage and no hedges have been executed.
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave is exploring the use of financial derivatives as a potential hedge against a future drop in memory and storage chip prices... Among the possibilities discussed are put options... The discussions are in their early stages and the company has not yet executed any hedges

key_facts.fact: To lock in supply, CoreWeave and other cloud operators have signed long-term agreements with memory and storage makers such as Micron and SanDisk that guarantee suppliers a price floor for DRAM and storage chips, leaving buyers exposed if prices fall.
key_facts.excerpt: cloud operators including CoreWeave have signed long-term agreements with memory and storage makers such as Micron and SanDisk. Many of these deals guarantee suppliers a price floor for dynamic random access memory (DRAM) and storage chips

sources.title: Exclusive-AI cloud company CoreWeave explores Wall Street playbook to hedge memory-chip price risk
